```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet")$schema
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  collect() |>
  slice_sample(n = 10) |>
  as_tibble()
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  group_by(coin_id) |>
  summarise(avg_market_cap_usd = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_market_cap_usd)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  collect()
metadata <- open_dataset("data/coin_metadata.parquet") |>
  collect()
categories <- open_dataset("data/categories.parquet") |>
  collect()

crypto <- prices |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(select(categories, -description), by = "category_id") |>
  mutate(date = ymd(date_raw))
```

```{r}
metadata |>
  mutate(launch_date_parsed = as.Date(lubridate::parse_date_time(
    launch_date,
    orders = c("B d, Y", "Y-m-d")
  ))) |>
  arrange(launch_date_parsed) |>
  select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date, launch_date_parsed)
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = price_usd)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Price (USD)", title = "Bitcoin Daily Price")
```

```{r}
category_shares <- crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarise(category_market_cap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(date) |>
  mutate(category_share = category_market_cap / sum(category_market_cap)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(category_name = forcats::fct_reorder(
    category_name,
    category_market_cap,
    .fun = mean
  ))

event_windows <- tibble(
  event = c("Luna/UST crash", "FTX collapse"),
  start = as.Date(c("2022-05-07", "2022-11-08")),
  end = as.Date(c("2022-05-12", "2022-11-11")),
  midpoint = as.Date(c("2022-05-09", "2022-11-09"))
)

ggplot(category_shares, aes(x = date, y = category_share, fill = category_name)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = event_windows,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey35",
    alpha = 0.18
  ) +
  geom_area() +
  geom_label(
    data = event_windows,
    aes(x = midpoint, y = 1.03, label = event),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3,
    label.size = 0,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Crypto Market Share by Category",
    subtitle = "Each band shows a category's share of total cryptocurrency market capitalization per day.",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Share of total market capitalization",
    fill = "Category",
    caption = "Source: Cryptocurrency daily market data and category metadata supplied with this analysis."
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1), clip = "off") +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 24, r = 8, b = 8, l = 8))
```
